# Support

Use [Discord](https://scalius.com/discord) for installation help, usage questions, and troubleshooting that has not yet been shown to be a product defect.

Use the repository's structured issue forms for reproducible bugs and product improvements. Keep each issue to one independently deliverable problem and remove secrets, credentials, OTPs, receipt proofs, session tokens, and buyer personal data before posting.

Security vulnerabilities must be reported privately according to the [security policy](../SECURITY.md), never through a public issue or Discord.
